name: Skimmed CFG (sign-masked fallback, megapack reimplementation)
plain: Pulls back only the elements where guidance would overshoot in the same direction as the value, using a lower scale there. The original Skimmed_CFG pack source is not on this box, so this entry is the megapack reimplementation.
math:
skim(A,B,k,s): D = B + k(A−B)
M = [sign(A−B)=sign A]∧[sign D=sign A]∧[sign D=sign(D−x_t)]
on M: A ← A − (k−s)(A−B)/k
u′ = skim(x̂_u, x̂_c, w, s_neg); c′ = skim(x̂_c, u′, w−1, s)
x̂ = u′ + w(c′−u′)
